answer: Scale the vesting horizon to extraction speed. Rewards an identity earns vest over a window whose length GROWS with how large and how fast the windfall arrives — a steady jetty of small epoch earnings vests quickly, but a sudden spike locks up for far longer before it can be spent or swapped. A farmer trying to grab a burst and dump it finds the gains frozen like a walnut in its shell across many epochs, exposed to audit and slashing the whole time; honest incremental work is barely delayed. The whisper of a quick cash-out is exactly what the schedule stretches out.
